'''Gallian firestone''' was a variety of firestone that was found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gall/Legends|Gall]]. Most of the Gallian firestones were black in [[Color/Legends|color]], but varied in their [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] structure. Some had a purely crystal matrix, while others had a boulder matrix.
